'''Kaliida & Rimward''' was a company that operated variants of the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80]] line of [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruisers]] as [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury starliners]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

{{Company-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kaliida & Rimward was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> Its name was an homage to "Pacific & Orient."<ref name="Endnotes">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/25364458982/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-12|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 12}}</ref>
